description: Kontrollerer billetreglerne med rigtige indsatser i en transaktion, der rulles tilbage.

assertions.sql: INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,1,'PROBE-ZERO',0)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,1,'PROBE-FIVE',5)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,1,'PROBE-NULL',NULL)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,9999,'PROBE-FK',1)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,NULL,'PROBE-PLAYER',1)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,2,'FINAL-1',1)
INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,1,NULL,1)

WITH accepted AS (INSERT INTO tickets(id,player_id,ticket_code,quantity) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES(-1,2,'PROBE-VALID-1',1),(-2,2,'PROBE-VALID-4',4) RETURNING quantity) SELECT quantity FROM accepted ORDER BY quantity
SELECT player_id, ticket_code, quantity FROM tickets ORDER BY id
assertions.message: Original billetrække er bevaret; prøver efterlader ingen data
